findings.title: Repeated logical ANSWER was keyed by turn and replayed after receiver completion
findings.evidence: First real Native Pilot report is FAIL with AGENT_UNAVAILABLE at the ANSWER branch after code-cli already SUCCEEDED. This is an observed existing run, not a reviewer-created reproduction.
findings.fix: Business correlation key uses actor/action/logical question plus a proposal hash; repeated identical content is skipped and conflicting reuse rejects. Second real run completed without replay failure.
findings.runtime_binding: Second run predates the subsequent actor/ownership/context hardening and is not used as fresh runtime evidence for those patches.

findings.title: Host control proposals could switch sender identity based only on action text
findings.static_counterexample: A WAIT proposal from code-cli containing action ANSWER previously entered a branch that sent as lead, bypassing the original proposer identity at the Host layer. The fixed fixture did not exercise the malformed branch.
findings.fix: QUESTION requires code-cli/resident, FORWARD_QUESTION requires resident/lead/reply_to code-cli, ANSWER requires lead/code-cli; all sends use the inspected current actor id.
findings.negative_runtime_reproduction: NOT_RUN by this reviewer; no Pilot code was generated or executed.

findings.title: Actual writer grants were not bound to admitted output ownership
findings.static_counterexample: The validator could admit an empty code-model outputs list with its intended file assigned to another writable task, while the driver still granted code-model the fixed ROLE_PATHS. That made the persisted ownership plan descriptive rather than enforced.
findings.fix: Before createAgent/createTask, actual resource-prefixed paths must exactly equal work.outputs and all admitted.owners must match the task. Real planned goal, model strategy, dependencies, acceptance, disk and turn budgets are now passed to native Task creation.
findings.negative_runtime_reproduction: NOT_RUN by this reviewer; static branches are fail-closed and final fixed-entry Pilot is pending.

findings.title: Frozen handoff plan omitted the original history policy
findings.static_counterexample: Create source under historyWindow A, reopen Host with B, handoff (or recover a pending handoff): destination create formerly read the current Host default rather than the original task policy.
findings.fix: TaskInput accepts validated explicit history_window; new handoff input always freezes original.history_window===true, and destination creation_hash includes that input. Pending legacy plans without a frozen boolean reject explicitly.
findings.verification: Root-run m17-history test 3 passes for both enabled->Host disabled and disabled->Host enabled, preserved native contract text, persisted handoff input and repeated same creation_hash. Reviewer read TAP and source only.

findings.title: Final handoff append bypassed the opt-in rolling history helper
findings.static_counterexample: A valid target can receive 32 real messages while a durable handoff is pending; the original direct contract append would fail at 33 references even with the window enabled.
findings.fix: Handoff now calls #history, stores the drop count and adds the exact dropped ContextSource to TASK_HISTORY_WINDOW_ADVANCED in the same existing state/audit transaction.
findings.verification: Root-run test 4 creates the pending handoff barrier, atomically adopts 32 messages with no model turn, completes handoff, observes 32 refs and drop counts, then reads every original payload and verifies the store. TAP 4/4 PASS; no reviewer execution.
